# Service and reader APIs

The public members (no `_` prefix) of every file in `services/` and every config reader, with the first sentence of the comment above each. Read one file instead of the whole service.


## services/

- [AudioManager](api/AudioManager.md): Pipewire audio state: the default output (sink) and input (source), every device and app stream, and helpers to control them.

- [BarManager](api/BarManager.md): BarManager holds the bar editor's working copy of the Bars config.
- [BatteryManager](api/BatteryManager.md): The laptop battery (UPower's display device, when it is one) and the power-saver profile, for the Battery widget and module, and the low battery notifications …
- [BluetoothManager](api/BluetoothManager.md): Bluetooth state and actions over the default adapter (BlueZ via Quickshell.Bluetooth).
- [BlurManager](api/BlurManager.md): The blur behind the shell's chrome: the border's frame, bars and their popouts, edge popouts, integrated edge menus and docks.

- [ChatManager](api/ChatManager.md): The chat: conversations, sending and streaming replies (ChatRequest, ChatProtocol), attachments, and their history on disk.
- [ChatRequest](api/ChatRequest.md): One streaming chat request, sent with curl.
- [ClaudeUsageManager](api/ClaudeUsageManager.md): Claude plan usage (the numbers Claude Code's /usage shows) for one or more Claude Code accounts, each a CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.
- [ClipboardManager](api/ClipboardManager.md): The clipboard history the launcher searches (":" or /clipboard), while Launcher.clipboard is on.

- [ConfigDraft](api/ConfigDraft.md): A working copy of one config section for an editor (settings, bar, overlay, edge menu, keybind and monitor editors).
- [ConfigManager](api/ConfigManager.md): ConfigManager handles loading, saving, and monitoring the configuration file

- [DesktopManager](api/DesktopManager.md): The desktop's modules: the layouts editor's draft of the Desktop section (`editor`, shown live on the desktop while it differs from the config), which of its l…
- [DockManager](api/DockManager.md): The docks' shared state and actions (the docks themselves are shell/Dock): which apps a dock shows on a screen (its pinned ones, then running ones, windows gro…
- [EdgeMenuManager](api/EdgeMenuManager.md): Which edge menus (EdgeMenusConfig) are open and which are pinned.
- [EditsManager](api/EditsManager.md): The editors' unsaved edits, by overlay page: which pages hold a dirty draft (the navigator's dots and the unsaved-changes strip), and saving or discarding them…
- [EmojiManager](api/EmojiManager.md): The emoji the launcher searches (";" or /emoji), while Launcher.emoji is on.
- [FileManager](api/FileManager.md): Synchronous whole-file reads, for the few places that need a file's contents during a binding or initializer (config, schema, theme, state).

- [GreetdManager](api/GreetdManager.md): The login itself, in the greeter (greeter.qml): who logs in, into which session, and the conversation with greetd (Quickshell's Greetd: PAM through greetd's IP…
- [GreeterManager](api/GreeterManager.md): Axiom as greetd's login screen, from the user's side (the greeter itself is greeter.qml, with GreetdManager).

- [HypridleManager](api/HypridleManager.md): hypridle, run by axiom (the Idle section).
- [HyprlandConfigManager](api/HyprlandConfigManager.md): Managed config, loading ~/.config/hypr/user/*.lua after it Whenever the file isn't loaded (included but the lines are missing, or a managed takeover refused), …
- [HyprlandManager](api/HyprlandManager.md): Provides access to some Hyprland data not available in Quickshell.Hyprland.
- [IdleInhibitManager](api/IdleInhibitManager.md): Shared on/off state for keeping the session awake.

- [KeyboardLayoutManager](api/KeyboardLayoutManager.md): Active xkb layout of the main keyboard, shared by every KeyboardLayout widget.
- [LauncherCommands](api/LauncherCommands.md): The launcher's slash commands, one per shell feature.
- [LauncherManager](api/LauncherManager.md): LauncherManager turns the launcher's search text into result rows and runs them.

- [MonitorManager](api/MonitorManager.md): The Monitors page: the connected outputs (`hyprctl monitors all -j`, read at startup and when monitors come, go or the config reloads; never polled) and the ed…
- [NetworkingManager](api/NetworkingManager.md): Wi-Fi state and actions over NetworkManager (Quickshell.Networking, D-Bus, so nothing polls).
- [NightLightManager](api/NightLightManager.md): The night light (the NightLight section): warmer colors through hyprsunset, or wlsunset without it, started and stopped by axiom.
- [NotesManager](api/NotesManager.md): Notes: Markdown files in NotesConfig.directory (config/state/notes/ by default, or a linked folder).
- [NotificationManager](api/NotificationManager.md): NotificationManager is the DBus notification server and the notification history.

- [PopoutManager](api/PopoutManager.md): Every popout showing, where it is, and which gives way to which.
- [SavedConfigsManager](api/SavedConfigsManager.md): Named snapshots of the config, one JSON file each in config/user/saved/.
- [ScreenLayoutEditor](api/ScreenLayoutEditor.md): The layouts editor's draft of one screen layout (a ScreenLayout: the built-in lock screen's, LockManager.editor, or the greeter's, GreeterManager.editor): its …
- [ScreenshotManager](api/ScreenshotManager.md): Screenshots (the `screenshot` keybind action, IPC `screenshot take <kind>`, launcher `/screenshot`, the Screenshot card), taken natively: while `picking`, shel…
- [SecretsManager](api/SecretsManager.md): Secrets, which never go in config.json: chat API keys (scope `provider`) and calendar account passwords (scope `calendar`).
- [SelfUpdateManager](api/SelfUpdateManager.md): Updates axiom itself (not packages: that's UpdatesManager).
- [SettingsManager](api/SettingsManager.md): The settings page's working copy of the config.
- [ShellManager](api/ShellManager.md): Shell manager manages global options and signals
- [StateManager](api/StateManager.md): Small JSON state files in Paths.statePath: createStateHandler(name) gives a shared save/load handler per name.
- [SystemManager](api/SystemManager.md): CPU / memory / temperature / GPU / disk usage, polled only while something is showing it.
- [TailscaleManager](api/TailscaleManager.md): Tailscale's state for every widget that shows it: one `tailscale status --json` at the shortest interval asked for, only while something has acquire()d it.

- [UpdatesManager](api/UpdatesManager.md): Pending package updates, shared by every Updates widget.
- [WallpaperManager](api/WallpaperManager.md): What changes the look on its own.
- [WeatherManager](api/WeatherManager.md): Weather shared by every widget that shows it: one WeatherSource for the Weather settings' location and units, fetching while some widget wants it.

- [WindowSwitcherManager](api/WindowSwitcherManager.md): The window switcher (Alt+Tab).

## config/

- [Appearance](api/Appearance.md): Reader for the Appearance section.
- [Apps](api/Apps.md): Reader for the Apps section: the apps axiom opens (keybinds, the launcher's terminal apps and Shift+Enter commands)
- [Bar](api/Bar.md): Reader for the Bars section and the bar look helpers: derived layout values (enrichBarConfig), widget colors, look groups and autoColor fields.
- [BarStyle](api/BarStyle.md): Reader for the BarStyle section: how every bar draws its widgets, accents and shadow, unless it overrides a group of them (Bar.enrichBarConfig)
- [BatteryConfig](api/BatteryConfig.md): Reader for the Battery section.
- [CalendarConfig](api/CalendarConfig.md): Reader for the Calendar section (see CalendarManager).
- [ChatConfig](api/ChatConfig.md): Reader for the Chat section.
- [DesktopConfig](api/DesktopConfig.md): Reader for the Desktop section: overlay modules on the desktop, under the windows.
- [DockConfig](api/DockConfig.md): Reader for the Dock section: any number of docks, each with its own place, pinned apps and behaviour (DockEntry in the schema).
- [EdgeMenusConfig](api/EdgeMenusConfig.md): EdgeMenus: menus that pop out of a screen edge, holding overlay modules.
- [General](api/General.md): Reader for the General section.
- [GreeterConfig](api/GreeterConfig.md): Reader for the Greeter section: axiom as the greetd login screen (GreeterManager sets it up; in the greeter itself, this is the bundle it was handed).
- [HyprlandConfig](api/HyprlandConfig.md): Reader for the Hyprland section: how axiom sets Hyprland up (HyprlandConfigManager).
- [I18n](api/I18n.md): Translation and locale for the shell's text (General.language).
- [IconsConfig](api/IconsConfig.md): Reader for the Icons section.
- [Idle](api/Idle.md): Reader for the Idle section: hypridle, run by HypridleManager.
- [LauncherConfig](api/LauncherConfig.md): Reader for the Launcher section (the search launcher).
- [LockscreenConfig](api/LockscreenConfig.md): Reader for the Lockscreen section: which locker locks the session, and what the built-in one shows (`layout`, as saved: the lock never shows the layouts editor…
- [NightLight](api/NightLight.md): Reader for the NightLight section: warmer colors through hyprsunset or wlsunset, run by NightLightManager.
- [NotesConfig](api/NotesConfig.md): Reader for the Notes section (see NotesManager).
- [NotificationsConfig](api/NotificationsConfig.md): Reader for the Notifications section (toasts and the history).
- [OSDConfig](api/OSDConfig.md): Reader for the OSD section (the volume, microphone and brightness on-screen displays).
- [OverlayConfig](api/OverlayConfig.md): Overlay: the configured views, plus the card grid's layout constants.
- [Paths](api/Paths.md): Derived, non-configurable filesystem paths (from the environment, not config).
- [PolkitConfig](api/PolkitConfig.md): Reader for the Polkit section: whether axiom is the session's polkit agent (PolkitManager)
- [PopoutsConfig](api/PopoutsConfig.md): Reader for the Popouts section: behaviour shared by bar popouts and screen-edge popouts.
- [PowerMenuConfig](api/PowerMenuConfig.md): Reader for the PowerMenu section.
- [Screenshots](api/Screenshots.md): Reader for the Screenshots section: where screenshots and recordings are saved (ScreenshotManager resolves the empty defaults)
- [SelfUpdate](api/SelfUpdate.md): Reader for the SelfUpdate section (see SelfUpdateManager).
- [Theme](api/Theme.md): The active theme's colors: base16 (base00-base0F) and semantic names, filled from theme-defaults.json; resolveColor(name) for names from config.
- [ThemeIntegrations](api/ThemeIntegrations.md): Reader for the ThemeIntegrations section: one switch per scripts/theme_<key>.sh, run by ThemeManager.themeIntegrations().
- [WeatherConfig](api/WeatherConfig.md): Reader for the Weather section: the one location and units every weather widget and module shows (see WeatherManager).
- [Widget](api/Widget.md): Reader for the Widget section: sizing for panels, cards, popouts and controls.
- [WindowSwitcherConfig](api/WindowSwitcherConfig.md): Reader for the WindowSwitcher section (Alt+Tab).
- [WorkspaceOverlayConfig](api/WorkspaceOverlayConfig.md): Reader for the WorkspaceOverlay section (the full-screen workspace overview).
- [WorkspacesConfig](api/WorkspacesConfig.md): Reader for the Workspaces section: the workspace layout the bar widget, the overview, the WorkspacesMap module and HyprlandManager's navigation share.
